hypothesis: endpoint-exact monotone per-channel curves capture nonlinear photographic tone and colour adjustment that the five-parameter logit-affine operator misses, while group-held-out source-only prediction plus shared-scale analytical safety improves fresh mean and tail error over its own global curve

operator.predicted_parameters: five interior output ordinates per channel in RGB order
operator.fit: per-channel isotonic regression of target channel on source channel with endpoint anchors, then sample fixed knots
operator.prediction_projection: per-channel isotonic projection with exact zero and one endpoints
operator.execution: piecewise linear interpolation followed by one analytical shared RGB residual scale per pixel

prediction.alpha_selection: inner complete camera-group cross-validation on outer-development only; full AY0 alpha by complete camera-group cross-validation

branch_rules.all_gates_pass: freeze the complete operator, projection, alpha selection and executor, then acquire another untouched official FiveK population for confirmation
branch_rules.oracle_fails: close the curve representation capacity without predictor rescue
branch_rules.predictor_or_tail_fails: close the fixed representation/predictor pair without knots, features, alphas, projection, target or AO6 rescue
branch_rules.boundary_fails: close as implementation or safety failure before visual review

claim_ceiling: development-only capacity and group-held-out generalization evidence for monotone explicit digital-retouch curves before fixed AO6; not film, stock, calibration, preference, confirmation or product promotion
